answer: Collateral-seeded task escrow. Each new identity must fund an escrow whose payout vests only after completing a verified task, and every escrow is anchored to a shared vertex in a public dependency graph. Sybils must each post that float, and the capital sits idle during vesting. An attacker cloning identities in an orchard of shells pays full escrow per clone while earning nothing until each fake completes real work, so the marginal clone is strictly negative-EV.
